name: Bun tom Chau Truc
summary: Shrimp noodles from Châu Trúc: live shrimp from the Trà Ổ lagoon pounded and stirred into boiling noodle water, with scallion, coriander, and pepper. A grilled rice cracker comes on the side.
origin: Thôn Châu Trúc, xã Mỹ Châu, huyện Phù Mỹ.
howToEat: The bowl is the pounded shrimp, a little seasoning and fish sauce, the boiling noodle water, then the noodles, scallion, coriander, and pepper. A grilled rice cracker is served with it.
where: Châu Trúc, Phù Mỹ, on the Trà Ổ lagoon.
seoTitle: Bun tom Chau Truc — shrimp noodles in Phu My
seoDescription: Bún tôm Châu Trúc is live Trà Ổ lagoon shrimp pounded into boiling noodle water, with scallion, coriander, and a rice cracker.
